processing_notes: Original authoritative 132-page PDF preserved without modification.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; representative first, middle, and final pages were rendered and visually reviewed.

items.large_file_assessment: 76,771,030-byte (73.21 MiB) authoritative 132-page PDF; unusually large because it includes full-resolution plan-and-profile sheets, cross-sections, cost estimates, and a preliminary drainage report. A smaller authoritative complete version was not found. Optimization could reduce fidelity, so the original is preserved. Projected R2 storage remains below 8 GB.
